items.description: S0-VTOL with ship launch and autonomous landing capability

notes: Preliminary concept phase for NOAA research vessel Ron Brown platform. Chidong Zhang (NOAA) proposing S0-VTOL for autonomous launch/recovery from ship, flight to surface vehicle, atmospheric sounding, and return. Requirements: ~15k ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical sounding, 45-day mission, 8-hour data turnaround, potential Spring 2028 deployment. Current $18k preliminary funding identified; pursuing additional Ron Brown funding. Publications collaboration expected. Beck Cotter is lead owner.
